title: Michael's right arm weak since the abduction

tellings.quote: Just after his abduction, Michael noticed that his right arm was sore.

plain: Right after he says he was abducted in 1977, at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, an Air Force man named Michael Johnson noticed that his right arm was sore, and it has been weak ever since. Michels tells this in his own narration of an episode where Air Force veterans who say they were abducted meet again 50 years later. He offers the arm as a lasting physical mark of the event.
